topics: Classification of solid wastes (source and type based)
ESSWM (environmentally sound solid waste management) and EST (environmentally sound technologies)
progress in MSW (municipal solid waste) management in India
Indian and global scenario of e-waste
health and environmental effects (public health and environmental)
COLLECTION, STORAGE, TRANSPORT AND DISPOSAL OF WASTES:
Identification and classification of hazardous waste
WASTE PROCESSING TECHNIQUES & SOURCE REDUCTION, PRODUCT RECOVERY & RECYCLING:
Source Reduction, Product Recovery and Recycling:
implementation monitoring and evaluation of source reduction

partA.description:
2 Questions from each module.
Total of 8 Questions, each carrying 3 marks

partB.description:
Each question carries 9 marks.
Two questions will be given from each module, out of which 1 question should be answered.
Each question can have a maximum of 3 sub divisions.

courseOutcomes.description: Understand the basics of solid waste management towards sustainable development
Undestand technologies to process waste and dispose the same.
Design working models to convert waste to energy
Identify and classify hazardous waste and manage the hazard
